pages.text: The $(item)Fusion Conductor$() automates a fusion setup. Place it directly on top of a $(item)Fusion Crafting Core$().$(br2)Pipes, hoppers, AE2 or Refined Storage put items into its input; finished items come out of its output. Without a conductor the core still works by hand.

pages.title: How it crafts
pages.text: It picks the first recipe it can fully load: catalyst, every ingredient, and enough empty injectors of a high enough tier. It uses the lowest tier that works, so Chaotic injectors stay free for Chaotic recipes.$(br2)When the craft is done the result goes to the output, and leftovers go back.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: With $(l)Power injectors$() on (the lightning button) it charges the injectors itself from its energy buffer, with ice-blue beams. Feed it OP, RF or FE from any side.$(br2)Turn it off to use your own crystals or pylons on the injectors instead.

pages.title: Capacitor upgrade
pages.text: Put a Draconic capacitor in the slot under the energy bar:$(li)Wyvern: 2x speed, 4x energy$(li)Draconic: 4x speed, 16x energy$(li)Chaotic: 8x speed, 64x energy$(br2)The capacitor is not drained. Low power only slows the craft down; it never cancels.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Recipe lock$(): click the slot holding the item you want, or use JEI's +. Right-click clears.$(li)$(l)Batch$(): craft this many, then stop.$(li)$(l)Redstone$(): ignore, run while powered, while not powered, or one craft per pulse.

pages.title: Live view
pages.text: The map beside the status shows the core and its injectors from above. Green: loaded by the conductor. Red: an item put there by hand, which stops the conductor until you take it out. Grey: empty.$(br2)The core's auto-craft, push output, show injectors and 1/64 buttons move to the conductor.

pages.title: More
pages.text: A comparator reads 1-14 while it crafts. With CC: Tweaked it is the peripheral $(l)fusion_conductor$(): status, start, lock, batch, stats.$(br2)Only the player who placed it, their team and operators can change its settings. Breaking it drops everything, including a craft in progress.
